import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,re,subprocess,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
ids=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids']; rows=[]
for x in json.loads(Path('historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text()):
 if any(t in x.lower() for t in ['code-loop','polynexus','crown','tournament','transitive-bunkbed','bunkbed','hat-','formal','r402','r395/']): rows.append({'path':x,'action':'protected-name skipped before opening'});continue
 p=Path(x)
 if not p.is_file():rows.append({'path':x,'action':'missing exact allowlist path'});continue
 s=p.read_text(); hits=[i for i in ids if re.search(r'(?<!\d)'+str(i)+r'(?!\d)',s)]
 rows.append({'path':x,'action':'completed result read','sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest(),'reserved_id_hits':hits})
 if hits: print('HISTORICAL HIT',x,hits,s[:2500])
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','history-read-inventory.json'],input=json.dumps(rows,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
print('HISTORY COUNTS',len(rows),sum(r['action']=='completed result read' for r in rows))
for n in ['prime','partition','rainbow']:
 p=Path(f'sources/{n}.pdf')
 if not p.exists():print(n,'UNAVAILABLE',Path(f'get-{n if n!="partition" else "partition"}.receipt.json').read_text()[-1200:]);continue
 t=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p),'-'],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py',f'sources/{n}.txt'],input=t,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
 print(n,'LENGTH',len(t));ls=t.splitlines();chosen=set()
 for i,l in enumerate(ls):
  if any(z in l.lower() for z in ['conjecture','forest number','define','theorem 1','b(n)','s(n)']): chosen.update(range(max(0,i-2),min(len(ls),i+14)))
 print('\n'.join(f'{i+1}: {ls[i]}' for i in sorted(chosen)))
for n in ['openai','deepmind']:
 s=Path(f'sources/{n}-root.html').read_text();print(n,'HEAD',re.findall(r'"currentOid":"([0-9a-f]+)"',s));print('MATCHES',re.findall(r'.{0,80}(?:sat-sharp|[Bb]i-root|[Oo]rder.polytope|[Nn]ilpotent|[Dd]ow.Gibson).{0,80}',s))
